title: Agent reportAbuse: Message/reportAbuse on the local endpoint (INVENTED), franks kept per Message in the plaintext store, Agent::report_abuse takes AbusiveMessages
description:
A JMAP Chat client knows Messages, not franks; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 and -mimi-00 define no report method. INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC.

1. mimid-agent-core: ReceivedMessage keeps the franked application_data as received (protocol-07 §5.9 message_content is that whole application_data, decision mimid-1wgh.6.66; re-encoding the MimiContent could change bytes). ReceivedMessage::abusive_message() gives the AbusiveMessage (message_content, frank, accepted_timestamp) for a franked message, none for an unfranked one. Agent::report_abuse(room, messages, reason, note) needs 1..=MAX_REPORTED_MESSAGES messages whose content's senderUri is one user (AbuseReport has one allegedAbuserUri) and whose roomUri is the room; reportingUser is always the agent's user; abuse_extensions empty. It does not verify the franks again (they were verified on receipt, protocol-07 §5.4.1.3); the hub verifies. It sends Room/reportAbuse (decision filed with this one) and returns the hub's answer as ReportOutcome.
2. mimid-agent-jmap: the plaintext store keeps, per received Message id, the room and the TLS-encoded AbusiveMessage, in the snapshot's 'franks' map (absent in older files: none), so a report works after a restart. Message/reportAbuse, registered beside crate-jmap's handlers and under the JMAP Chat capability (the agent's endpoint advertises no other): arguments accountId, messageIds (1 to MAX_REPORTED_MESSAGES Message ids of one Chat), reasonCode (0-255, default 0, AbuseType of §5.9, which defines no codes yet, decision mimid-1wgh.5.32), note (a string, default empty, at most MAX_NOTE_LEN octets). A Message with no kept frank (the user's own, one stored from an unfranked room, one never received) is invalidArguments naming it, before anything is sent. Answer {accountId, responseCode} as the server's.
3. Limitations: unfranked messages cannot be reported (AbusiveMessage needs a Frank); a report with no messages, or an anonymous one, is not offered.
notes:
Mark 2026-11-18: allow unverified reports. protocol-07 §5.9 AbusiveMessage requires a Frank, so unfranked messages go in an INVENTED abuse_extensions component (private-use id) marked unverified; other hubs skip it; a mimid hub records them as unverified. Being built.
2026-11-19 (Mark's decision of 2026-11-18, built on branch report-abuse-2): item 3's Limitation is reversed. Agent::report_abuse takes ReportedMessage (Franked(AbusiveMessage) | Unfranked(UnverifiedAbusiveMessage)); ReceivedMessage::reported_message() gives one for every received message. Franked ones go in messages, unfranked ones in abuse_extensions component 0xF020 (decision mimid-1wgh.60); the component is left out when there are none. Contents must still carry senderUri and roomUri (one alleged abuser, the room). mimid-agent-jmap keeps, per received Message, either the AbusiveMessage or (unverified: true in the snapshot's 'franks' entry) the UnverifiedAbusiveMessage; older entries without the flag read as franked. Message/reportAbuse no longer refuses an unfranked Message; it still refuses the user's own Messages, unknown ids, Messages of other Chats and the limits. Reporter always named.
